newsitem.title: USA: KV Pharmaceutical sets $22 mln credit pact.
newsitem.headline: KV Pharmaceutical sets $22 mln credit pact.

text.p: KV Pharmaceutical Co said Tuesday it completed an agreement for an unsecured revolving line of credit and letter of credit facility totaling $22.6 million with LaSalle National Bank of Chicago.
This replaces KV's previously secured banking arrangement, with another lending institution, for $17.5 million.
The new unsecured arrangement is for a three-year term at the prime rate.
KV Pharmaceutical develops, makes and markets controlled-release, site specific and taste-masked forms of drug products using proprietary drug delivery and taste-masking technologies.
Shares of KV Pharmaceutical were trading unchanged at 17-1/8.
